newsitem.title: USA: Easco Inc sees Q3 loss includes charge.
newsitem.headline: Easco Inc sees Q3 loss includes charge.

text.p: Easco Inc said on Monday that it expects to report a third quarter loss of approximately $1 million, or $0.10 a share, including a charge of $1.8 million.
The charge reflects losses on work in process and accounts receivable for a customer experiencing financial difficulties, Easco said.

Easco reported profits of $1.1 million, or $0.10 a share, in last year's third quarter. The consensus forecast by analysts covering Easco was for the company to earn $0.23 a share in the third quarter, according to First Call.
Easco said it expects to return to "modest profitability" in the fourth quarter.
Order activity continues to remain strong and third quarter shipments is expected to be near the 86 million pounds shipped by Easco in the second quarter, Easco said.
Easco said its third quarter results will be issued during the third full week of October.
